findings.problem: TASK-105 adds a NEW required field (SupportsDryRun) to OperationDef and makes ValidateOpDef reject any CapLibraryWrite def that leaves it false. SupportsDryRun does not exist anywhere in the repo today, so every write-capable def defaults to false the moment step 2 lands. ValidateOpDef is called by RegisterOp, RegisterOp returns the error, and every plugin's Register loop returns on first error — so the failure is not 'ops silently skipped', it aborts registration for the whole plugin and propagates to boot. exact_files lists 2 files; 88 non-test files reference CapLibraryWrite. Worse, step 3's own audit grep is scoped to internal/plugins/ and therefore misses ~17 files under internal/server/ and internal/scheduler/extra_ops.go (11 RegisterOp call sites in that one file), which are exactly the ops that would then fail to register.
